context.title: Tests document current behaviour, one module per contribution
context.body: A contribution to the test suite touches exactly one module's test file in packages/remeda/src and adds cases that pass against the current implementation: empty input, boundary values, data-first and data-last forms, and the lazy pipe path where the function has one. Library behaviour does not change in these contributions. A case that fails against the current code is a bug to describe in the commit message, not to fix.

context.title: Tests follow the file they extend
context.body: New cases use the same vitest style as the file they join (describe, test, expect, expectTypeOf where the file already uses it), the same import paths, and no new dependencies. Each new test has a name that says which behaviour it pins down.

objective.title: Every function's tests cover its edge cases
criteria: Each of the 24 listed modules has tests for empty input, boundaries, both call forms and the lazy path where one exists
No change to src/*.ts outside the test files
The runtime tests and the type check pass on every accepted checkpoint
